name: english-drawlog
description: The English patch plus the drawn-text log (src/patch/drawlog/drawlog.c): every string drawn through set_kanji_string that still carries Japanese is recorded in a RAM ring with its scene, step, position and address, for tools/patch/draw_log.py to decode from a regtest RAM dump. A regression-test build only (the ring takes ~6 KB of the kanji block, so this build has no kanji subset). Output: build/patch/english-drawlog/.

pokes.note: text_vwf.c set_kanji_string calls the hook when this word is a code address (1 = off in the release profile)
